She’s polite, just normal friendly, but I can tell by little things—how she looks in the mirror, the way she asks for my cab—that she’s sending me messages. I’m convinced she’s dropping hints through her social media posts too, like coded messages just for me, even though we barely know each other.

I work every day, pay my bills, talk to customers fine. My routine’s the same, except I’ll sometimes adjust my route in case I might pass by where she lives or works. My friends say I’m reading too much into it, but they just don’t see what I see.

Over the last few months I’ve had periods where I feel really low—no energy, trouble sleeping, lost interest in watching football, that sort of thing—but even when I’m down, the belief about her doesn’t change. When my mood lifts for a while, that feeling that she loves me is still there, just as strong as before.
D004-D015_h025.options:
A. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    B. Body Dysmorphic Disorder
    C. Delusional Disorder
    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
